# TCDev

> Personal portfolio of Riccardo (online as TCDev): developer and photographer in Bergamo. Software projects plus photo galleries. Site is bilingual (Italian and English).

Mi chiamo Riccardo, online mi trovi come TCDev. Sono uno sviluppatore e fotografo di Bergamo: progetto e scrivo software, e fotografo paesaggi e natura, ritratti e eventi.

I'm Riccardo, online as TCDev. I'm a developer and photographer from Bergamo: I build software, and I shoot landscapes and nature, portraits, and events.

Photo albums cover landscapes and nature, portraits and people, and events. Albums are managed from a private admin area (not for public crawl or citation).
